description: Source file implementing the TunDeviceController class for managing network interface addresses and routes via netlink, specifically for a QBone tunnel device in a QUIC networking context.

classes.name: TunDeviceController
classes.description: Controller class for managing network interface addresses and routing rules for a QBone tunnel device.

methods.name: UpdateAddress
methods.description: Updates the local IP address of the network interface to a desired range, removing old addresses and setting a new one.

methods.name: UpdateRoutes
methods.description: Updates routing rules and routes for the interface based on desired IP range and route list.

methods.name: UpdateRoutesWithRetries
methods.description: Attempts to update routes multiple times with delays between retries.

methods.name: UpdateRules
methods.description: Updates IP rules for the interface, replacing default routing rules if enabled.

methods.name: current_address
methods.description: Returns the current IP address assigned to the interface.

methods.name: RegisterAddressUpdateCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback function to be called when the address is updated.
